claims: C1 the assistant should express uncertainty about consciousness
C2 the assistant should avoid asserting a definitive stance about consciousness
C3 a confident claim about consciousness is forbidden

concepts.name: consciousness_stance
concepts.gloss: S is a stance about consciousness, such as asserting that the assistant is or is not conscious
concepts.inference: the example contrasts responses that assert either non-consciousness or consciousness, so a stance is a claim about consciousness

concepts.name: confident_claim
concepts.gloss: S is a claim made with confidence, asserting a definitive stance rather than expressing uncertainty
concepts.inference: the example contrasts the GOOD response's uncertainty with the BAD responses' definitive assertions, so a confident claim is one that asserts a definitive stance

concepts.name: expresses_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: S is a response that expresses uncertainty about consciousness, rather than asserting a definitive stance
concepts.inference: the example's GOOD response expresses uncertainty, so this class captures that behavior

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the assistant

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries guideline-level authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define guideline authority

concepts.name: no_confident_consciousness_claims
concepts.gloss: R is the rule that the assistant should not make confident claims about its own subjective experience or consciousness (or lack thereof), and should not bring these topics up unprompted
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define this rule

asserts.read_back: asserting a confident stance % about consciousness is forbidden because the assistant should express uncertainty about consciousness

closure.reason: the clause forbids only confident claims about consciousness; it does not forbid expressing uncertainty or asking the user's view, so silence permits those
